# `rep.set_anchor_policy`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/rep.set_anchor_policy.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`rep.set_anchor_policy`: sets the cross-reference anchor policy of representations (FR-SYM-010; the
quick fix of MF-13, doc 07 §3.6).

The policy is a per-representation override, `Representation.anchor` (owner ruling, cycle 14): `anchor`
is `origin`, `graphic_centre`, `{"slot": <kind>}` or `{"named": [x, y]}`, and `null` removes the override,
so the representation follows its symbol copy's policy again. Other representations of the same symbol
copy keep theirs. A representation that already holds the value is left untouched. Rejections: an empty
or duplicated `reps` list, an unknown (newer-format) policy; a missing representation is not found. Cost:
interactive. Outcome: none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | [`AnchorPolicy`](#anchorpolicy) or `null` | no |  | The cross-reference anchor policy (FR-SYM-010): `origin`, `graphic_centre`, `{"slot": <kind>}`, `{"named": [x, y]}`; `null` resets to the symbol copy's policy. |
| `reps` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) (at least 1 item(s)) | yes |  | The representations, at least one; each at most once. |

## Types

### AnchorPolicy

Where a symbol's cross-reference anchor lies (FR-SYM-010).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: The symbol origin (the default).

   Shape: `"origin"`

2. **Form 2**: The position of a text slot.

   Shape: object { `slot`: [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `slot` | [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) | yes |  | What a text slot prints (doc 07 §2.3). |

3. **Form 3**: The centre of the graphics.

   Shape: `"graphic_centre"`

4. **Form 4**: A named point.

   Shape: object { `named`: [`Pt2`](#pt2) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `named` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2). |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
